threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still trust the buses to be on time after seeing them delay since the last Tube strike. Real locals just ride the chaos like it's normal.
Last night on the 35, a guy in a suit was singing opera, while the driver pretended not to notice. Only in Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When a late-night kebab run turned into a spontaneous dance party with the guys from the corner shop. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice the buskers in the U-Bahn? Some of them are so good, you’ll end up missing your stop just to hear one more song.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they nonchalantly step over an abandoned bike without a second glance. It’s just another Tuesday in the Mission.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a dog napping on the Civic Center tracks today. Only in SF could a pup hold up a whole line. Priorities, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can find real paella at every restaurant, but most locals wouldn't touch the stuff outside of the coast. It's all about the calçots here.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by their bewildered faces at the ticket machines, still tapping in English while locals zip through in Catalan.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look bewildered when the bus driver yells at you for trying to tap your card on entry instead of exit.
Caught a night bus home last week, and a guy was trying to sell flowers to everyone. He had a full-on bouquet but no real plan. Pure Bermondsey vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a spontaneous dance party break out in the middle of the Sonnenallee, complete with a DJ on a bicycle. Only in Neukölln!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a party in a former power plant and a quiet park next door. It’s like techno and nature share a handshake here.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they know the difference between a 'taco truck' and a 'taco cart'—and can tell you where to find the best of each.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a stray dog taking a nap on the tracks at Civic Center yesterday—Muni halted, but it seemed like no one wanted to wake him up.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about gaudí, but the real charm is in those little square bars where locals still argue over football.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their overenthusiastic photo ops at the Boqueria, snap out of it and just enjoy the market!
